judge.rationale: The agent correctly identifies the three studio members connected to Beacon Grid—Silas Brandt, Theo Kanda, and Noor Haddad—but omits the key role facts from the reference: Silas (data/DuckDB ingestion pipeline), Theo (systems/ingest), and Noor (dashboard). It adds unsupported graph-edge and other-project details and incorrectly concludes the role information is unavailable rather than reporting it.
